      <!DOCTYPE html>
      <html lang="fr">
      <head>
      <meta charset="UTF-8">
      <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
      <title>Déso Burger - Pointeuse</title>
      <script crossorigin src="https://unpkg.com/react@18/umd/react.production.min.js"></script>
      <script crossorigin src="https://unpkg.com/react-dom@18/umd/react-dom.production.min.js"></script>
      <script src="https://unpkg.com/@babel/standalone/babel.min.js"></script>
      <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
      <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>
      <script>
      // =========================================================
      // SUPABASE CONFIG - tout ici, hors du script Babel
      // =========================================================
      var SB = window.supabase.createClient(
      'https://heeesfhlilaktnemzyff.supabase.co',
      'sb_publishable_AwlVGd6-XmKFKNCpmGGFGQ_JMohoAzp'
      );
      // Helpers de mapping
      function empFromDB(e) {
      return { id: e.id, name: e.name, pin: e.pin, isLoggedIn: e.is_logged_in,
      pointsPerHour: parseFloat(e.points_per_hour)||1, hourlyRate: parseFloat(e.hourly_rate)||16,
      breakThreshold: parseFloat(e.break_threshold)||5, breakDuration: parseFloat(e.break_duration)||30,
      ftCommissionRate: parseFloat(e.ft_commission_rate)||3,
      birthdate: e.birthdate || null,
      message: e.message||null,
      broadcastMessage: e.broadcast_message||null };
      }
      function empToDB(emp) {
      return { id: emp.id, name: emp.name, pin: emp.pin, is_logged_in: emp.isLoggedIn,
      points_per_hour: emp.pointsPerHour, hourly_rate: emp.hourlyRate,
      break_threshold: emp.breakThreshold, break_duration: emp.breakDuration,
      ft_commission_rate: emp.ftCommissionRate || 3,
      birthdate: emp.birthdate || null,
      message: emp.message||null,
      broadcast_message: emp.broadcastMessage||null };
      }
      function recFromDB(r) {
      return { id: r.id, employeeId: r.employee_id, employeeName: r.employee_name,
      type: r.type, timestamp: r.timestamp, location: r.location||'restaurant',
      forceBreakOverride: r.force_break_override };
      }
      function recToDB(r) {
      return { id: r.id, employee_id: r.employeeId, employee_name: r.employeeName,
      type: r.type, timestamp: r.timestamp, location: r.location||'restaurant',
      force_break_override: r.forceBreakOverride !== undefined ? r.forceBreakOverride : null };
      }
      function msgFromDB(m) {
      return { id: m.id, employeeId: m.employee_id, employeeName: m.employee_name,
      message: m.message, date: m.date, read: m.read };
      }
      function ftFromDB(e) {
      return { id: e.id, employeeId: e.employee_id, employeeName: e.employee_name,
      punchInId: e.punch_in_id, eventNumber: e.event_number, menuType: e.menu_type,
      price: e.price, peopleServed: e.people_served, employeesWorking: e.employees_working,
      commission: e.commission, date: e.date };
      }
      function ftToDB(e) {
      return { id: e.id, employee_id: e.employeeId, employee_name: e.employeeName,
      punch_in_id: e.punchInId, event_number: e.eventNumber, menu_type: e.menuType,
      price: e.price, people_served: e.peopleServed, employees_working: e.employeesWorking,
      commission: e.commission, date: e.date };
      }
      function alertFromDB(a) {
      return { id: a.id, employeeId: a.employee_id, employeeName: a.employee_name,
      suggestedDate: a.suggested_date, suggestedTime: a.suggested_time, createdAt: a.created_at };
      }
      function alertToDB(a) {
      return { id: a.id, employee_id: a.employeeId, employee_name: a.employeeName,
      suggested_date: a.suggestedDate, suggested_time: a.suggestedTime, created_at: a.createdAt };
      }
      // DB API - retourne des Promises, utilisé avec .then() dans React
      var DB = {
      loadAll: function() {
      return Promise.all([
      SB.from('employees').select('*').order('name'),
      SB.from('punch_records').select('*').order('timestamp', {ascending:false}),
      SB.from('employee_messages').select('*').order('date', {ascending:false}),
      SB.from('foodtruck_events').select('*').order('date', {ascending:false}),
      SB.from('pending_alerts').select('*').order('created_at', {ascending:false})
      ]).then(function(results) {
      return {
      employees: (results[0].data||[]).map(empFromDB),
      punchRecords: (results[1].data||[]).map(recFromDB),
      employeeMessages: (results[2].data||[]).map(msgFromDB),
      foodtruckEvents: (results[3].data||[]).map(ftFromDB),
      pendingAlerts: (results[4].data||[]).map(alertFromDB)
      };
      });
      },
      saveEmployee: function(emp) {
      return SB.from('employees').upsert(empToDB(emp), {onConflict:'id'});
      },
      saveEmployees: function(emps) {
      return Promise.all(emps.map(function(e){ return DB.saveEmployee(e); }));
      },
      deleteEmployee: function(id) {
      return SB.from('employees').delete().eq('id', id);
      },
      savePunchRecord: function(r) {
      return SB.from('punch_records').upsert(recToDB(r), {onConflict:'id'});
      },
      deletePunchRecord: function(id) {
      return SB.from('punch_records').delete().eq('id', id);
      },
      saveEmployeeMessage: function(m) {
      return SB.from('employee_messages').upsert(
      {id:m.id, employee_id:m.employeeId, employee_name:m.employeeName,
      message:m.message, date:m.date, read:m.read}, {onConflict:'id'});
      },
      deleteEmployeeMessage: function(id) {
      return SB.from('employee_messages').delete().eq('id', id);
      },
      markEmployeeMessageRead: function(id) {
      return SB.from('employee_messages').update({read:true}).eq('id', id);
      },
      saveFoodtruckEvent: function(e) {
      return SB.from('foodtruck_events').upsert(ftToDB(e), {onConflict:'id'});
      },
      deleteFoodtruckEvent: function(id) {
      return SB.from('foodtruck_events').delete().eq('id', id);
      },
      savePendingAlert: function(a) {
      return SB.from('pending_alerts').upsert(alertToDB(a), {onConflict:'id'});
      },
      deletePendingAlert: function(id) {
      return SB.from('pending_alerts').delete().eq('id', id);
      }
      };
      </script>
      </head>
      <body>
      <div id="root"></div>
      <script type="text/babel">
      const { useState, useEffect } = React;
      function PunchClockApp() {
      // États de base
      const [employees, setEmployees] = useState([]);
      const [punchRecords, setPunchRecords] = useState([]);
      const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = useState(new Date());
      const [message, setMessage] = useState('');
      const [showAdmin, setShowAdmin] = useState(false);
      const [showAdminLogin, setShowAdminLogin] = useState(false);
      const [activeAdminTab, setActiveAdminTab] = useState('gestion');
      const ADMIN_PASSWORDS = ['3175', '1816']; // David, Adam
      const [adminPasswordInput, setAdminPasswordInput] = useState('');
      const [pinInput, setPinInput] = useState('');
      const [newEmployeeName, setNewEmployeeName] = useState('');
      const [newEmployeePin, setNewEmployeePin] = useState('');
      const [newEmployeeHourlyRate, setNewEmployeeHourlyRate] = useState('');
      const [newEmployeeCommission, setNewEmployeeCommission] = useState('');
      const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
      const [broadcastMessage, setBroadcastMessage] = useState('');
      const [broadcastPhoto, setBroadcastPhoto] = useState(null);
      const [randomMessages, setRandomMessages] = useState([
      "Bonne journee!",
      "Go go go!",
      "Belle journee en perspective!",
      "On est une belle equipe!",
      {mdoMode === 'les2' && (
      <div className="bg-gray-800 text-white rounded-xl p-5">
      <h3 className="text-lg font-bold mb-3">📊 Total combiné</h3>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 text-sm">
      <div className="bg-gray-700 rounded-lg p-3">
      <div className="opacity-70">Salaires bruts</div>
      <div className="text-xl font-bold">{(r.totalSalaireResto + r.totalSalaireFt).toFixed(2)} $</div>
      </div>
      <div className="bg-gray-700 rounded-lg p-3">
      <div className="opacity-70">DAS total</div>
      <div className="text-xl font-bold text-orange-400">{(r.dasResto + r.dasFt).toFixed(2)} $</div>
      </div>
      <div className="bg-white text-gray-800 rounded-lg p-3">
      <div className="text-gray-500">Coût total</div>
      <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{r.coutTotal.toFixed(2)} $</div>
      </div>
      <div className={`col-span-3 rounded-lg p-3 text-center ${r.pctTotal > 35 ? 'bg-red-500' : r.pctTotal > 28 ? 'bg-yellow-500' : 'bg-green-500'}`}>
      <div className="opacity-80 text-sm">% des ventes totales</div>
      <div className="text-3xl font-bold">{r.ventesTotales > 0 ? r.pctTotal.toFixed(1) + '%' : '—'}</div>
      </div>
      </div>
      </div>
      )}
      </div>
      {/* Détail par employé */}
      {r.detailEmployes.length > 0 && (
      <div className="mt-6">
      <h3 className="text-lg font-bold mb-3 text-gray-700">Détail par employé</h3>
      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
      <table className="w-full border-collapse text-sm">
      <thead>
      <tr className="bg-gray-100">
      <th className="border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-left">Employé</th>
      {showResto && <th className="border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-center bg-blue-50">🍔 Heures</th>}
      {showResto && <th className="border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-center bg-blue-50">Salaire</th>}
      {showResto && <th className="border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-center bg-blue-50">+ DAS</th>}
      {showFt && <th className="border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-center bg-orange-50">🚚 Heures</th>}
      {showFt && <th className="border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-center bg-orange-50">Salaire</th>}
      {showFt && <th className="border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-center bg-orange-50">+ DAS</th>}
      </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
      {r.detailEmployes.map((emp, i) => (
      <tr key={i} className="hover:bg-gray-50">
      <td className="border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 font-semibold">{emp.name}</td>
      {showResto && <td className="border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-center bg-blue-50">{emp.heuresResto > 0 ? emp.heuresResto.toFixed(2) + 'h' : '—'}</td>}
      {showResto && <td className="border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-center bg-blue-50">{emp.salaireResto > 0 ? emp.salaireResto.toFixed(2) + ' $' : '—'}</td>}
      {showResto && <td className="border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-center bg-blue-50 font-semibold">{emp.salaireResto > 0 ? (emp.salaireResto * 1.168).toFixed(2) + ' $' : '—'}</td>}
      {showFt && <td className="border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-center bg-orange-50">{emp.heuresFt > 0 ? emp.heuresFt.toFixed(2) + 'h' : '—'}</td>}
      {showFt && <td className="border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-center bg-orange-50">{emp.salaireFt > 0 ? emp.salaireFt.toFixed(2) + ' $' : '—'}</td>}
      {showFt && <td className="border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-center bg-orange-50 font-semibold">{emp.salaireFt > 0 ? (emp.salaireFt * 1.168).toFixed(2) + ' $' : '—'}</td>}
      </tr>
      ))}
      </tbody>
      </table>
      </div>
      </div>
      )}
      {r.detailEmployes.length === 0 && (
      <div className="mt-6 text-center py-8 text-gray-400">
      Aucune donnée pour cette période
      </div>
      )}
      </div>
      </div>
      );
      }
      ReactDOM.render(<PunchClockApp />, document.getElementById('root'));
      </script>
      </body>
      </html>
